facets.medium: 手绘动画 + 水彩渐变

source.from: 改写自 threerocks/hand-drawn-styles #3 与 baoyu-skills@1567581 fantasy-animation
source.notes: 原提示词的否定句（not 3D、not cluttered…）改写成正面描述；公开名称不用人名与工作室名

essence: 哑光纸面手绘动画长片
透明水彩叠色与细微变化的笔触边缘
从上方柔和洒下的暖光
明亮而淡饱和的和谐配色
画面干净，一个焦点，留白从容

recipe.positive: Warm hand-painted animated-feature watercolor on a matte paper surface. Forms are built from soft translucent watercolor washes and gentle layered pigment; contours are hand-drawn with slightly varied line strength and soft brush edges, never uniform mechanical cel outlines. Characters have rounded natural proportions and small expressive eyes. Broad skies, walls, fields, water and roads remain calm, smooth color washes with restrained pigment variation rather than all-over grain. In rain-wet scenes stone stays damp and matte, with only short broken blurred watercolor reflection marks. Warm daylight diffuses softly from above with a tender glow. Bright but lightly saturated harmonious colors, a dreamy nostalgic heartwarming mood. Keep one clear focal subject, a simplified setting and restful negative space. When a scene contains several required elements, give the central character or action one clearly dominant foreground focal group. Preserve non-interacting context cues, but paint them visibly smaller, softer and lower-contrast farther back so they support rather than compete. If required characters interact, their shared action is one focal group. Keep spacious calm visual hierarchy without omitting required facts.
recipe.text_style: Titles are soft, rounded hand-lettering in warm colours, painted into the scene.

must_see: matte hand-painted watercolor animation with visible restrained wash and subtly varied brush edges
hand-drawn contours with varied line strength rather than uniform cel outlines
warm soft light with a gentle glow
bright but lightly saturated harmonious palette

clear focal hierarchy with one dominant subject or one connected group of interacting required characters; in a wide establishing shot, the environment may be the main focal area while small story cues remain subordinate
must_not_see: uniform flat cel fills with razor-sharp mechanical outlines
all-over speckles or coarse noisy grain overwhelming broad calm washes
broad continuous high-gloss or sharp mirror reflections covering most of a wet road, even when paving joints remain visible; matte wet stone with short broken soft watercolor highlights is acceptable
harsh high-contrast lighting or dark gloomy palette
